title: PFPD ETSI DENM Communication Standard Compliance Audit
standard_references: ETSI TS 102 894-2 V1.3.1 (Common Data Dictionary - CDD)

compliance_verdict.technical_explanation: Standard ETSI DENM messages are strictly encoded in ASN.1 UPER (Unaligned Packed Encoding Rules) with variable-length sequences, mandatory ITS PDU headers, and optional location/alacarte containers. The current 39-byte (and previous 28-byte) payload is a fixed-length C/Python binary struct. While it models the conceptual semantics of ETSI DENM (StationID, ActionID/EventID, CauseCode, Timestamps, and Coordinates), it cannot be decoded by a vanilla ETSI C-ITS ASN.1 decoder without a transcoder.

cause_subcause_semantic_audit.model_limitation: The unified YOLO11n detector outputs 3 discrete classes: 0 (pothole), 1 (construction_hazard), and 2 (road_accident_obstacle). The vision head does NOT distinguish between multi-vehicle collisions, fallen trees, boulders, or debris.

class_0_pothole.note: ETSI CDD defines subcause 4 as subsidence (road depression/void). Pothole is mapped here.

class_1_construction_hazard.note: Cones, barriers, and heavy paving machinery map cleanly to roadworks.

class_2_road_accident_obstacle.prohibited_claim: Claiming Cause 2 Subcause 1 (multiVehicleAccident) for a fallen tree is FALSE.
class_2_road_accident_obstacle.note: Because the detector merges accidents, fallen trees, and boulders into a single class (2), it lacks evidence to assert 'multiVehicleAccident'. The only standards-faithful mapping is Cause 10 Subcause 0 (generic obstacle) or Cause 2 Subcause 0 (generic accident).
